description: Change server settings: name, description, icon, banner, splash, verification level, default notifications, content filter, AFK, system and rules channels.

banner.description: Image path or URL (needs boost level 2), or "none"

bot.description: Use this bot (name or id) instead of choosing automatically

community.description: Turn Community on (needs rules_channel and public_updates_channel; raises verification to low and the content filter to all members if lower). Unlocks onboarding, welcome screen, announcement channels and forums insights

dry_run.description: Show the requests that would be made without changing anything

icon.description: Image path or URL, or "none" to remove

join_messages.description: Discord's own welcome message in the system channel when someone joins

reason.description: Reason shown in the server's audit log

server.description: Server name or id. Optional when the bot is in one server or DISCORD_GUILD_ID is set.

splash.description: Invite background image path or URL (needs boost level 1), or "none"

name: edit_server
